A '''mission''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was an attempt by [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] to recover a root from the [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa]] plant, which had been identified as a possible antidote to the deadly [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].

==Prelude==
[[File:TeamRepublicInfected-MoaTM.png|thumb|left|200px|Ahsoka Tano and her clone team are infected by Blue Shadow Virus]]
When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] learned that Separatist-allied [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] was planning on re-releasing the deadly [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], they led a [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|raid]] on Dr. Vindi's [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in which Dr. Vindi was captured and his plan was stopped. However, his servant droid [[LEP-86C8/Legends|LEP-86C8]] later managed to detonate a [[Viral bomb/Legends|virus bomb]], and the virus immediately started to spread through the lab. Ahsoka, [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were infected with the virus, and later [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] would be infected as well. To save their friends, Obi-Wan and Anakin immediately went to [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] following a lead for a possible antidote: the root of the [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa]] plant.

==The mission==
As [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] neared [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], the Jedi passed through a strange graveyard of ships. Landing on [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]], Anakin and Obi-Wan were welcomed by strangely disfigured Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Anakin hacked his way through a number of them before Obi-Wan brought to his attention that they weren't defending themselves. A boy appeared, introducing himself as [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]], upset that months of work reprogramming the droids had gone to waste. Despite such, he led the two Jedi to the location of a nearby Reeksa, at the bottom of a cliff. As the Jedi descended the cliff, a [[Xandu/Legends|Xandu]] swooped by, and Anakin grabbed it by the leg, with Obi-Wan hitching a ride as well. The two dropped down, accidentally touching the vines on the ground and disturbing the Reeksa. Anakin proceeded to dig up the root and escaped alive with Obi-Wan. <div style="float:right">[[File:MissionToIego-MoaTM.png|thumb|200px|Skywalker and Kenobi obtain reeksa root from Iego]]</div>

In their attempt to leave the planet, they were attacked by "[[Drol/Legends|Drol]]," the phantom god of Iego, which turned out to be a Separatist [[Force field/Legends|laser web]] installed to prevent Iego's inhabitants from leaving the planet. After learning from an [[Diathim/Legends|Angel]] that [[Millius Prime/Legends|Millius Prime]] could be a candidate for the field's generator, the two Jedi used Jaybo's [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] to fly through the laser grid so they could confirm the generator's spot and destroy it. "Drol" was destroyed, and the Jedi left with the cure.

==Aftermath==
Anakin and Obi-Wan returned to Naboo in time, and they were able to save Ahsoka, Padmé, Rex and the clone troopers. The recovering patients were transported away in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT gunships]], and were expected to make a full recovery.
